description: Sanghar Sugar Mills Limited is a public limited company incorporated on 5 May 1986, which went into commercial production in January 1988. It manufactures and sells sugar at a mill on the Sanghar–Sindhari road in Deh Kehore, District Sanghar, Sindh, where capacity has grown from an initial 2,000 tons of cane a day to 8,500 tons a day.
